# Tono 0.0.86 (build 87)
Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 26.3+.
## Changes since build 86
- **Signed TCP direct IPs** (#1856): The signed `traffic-policy` can now carry `tcpDirectAddresses` (non-DNS IPv4 TCP destinations) and v5 `tcpEndpoints`. These addresses are sent direct and admitted by the helper's fail-closed filter, so a policy update can add or change them without a client rebuild. The helper protocol version moves with this build.

# Tono 0.0.85 (build 86)
Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 26.3+.
## Changes since build 85
- **Expanded China direct routing & LAN access** (#1850): Added domestic direct coverage including `.cn`, ToDesk, `assetcloud.zj.gov.cn`, Gitee, Jimeng (`jimeng.jianying.com`), and Aliyun Wanwang (`wanwang.aliyun.com`), moved mainland `dashscope.aliyuncs.com` back to direct, and enabled local LAN device access by default on macOS. - **Zero-downtime policy key rotation & read fallback** (#1851): Rotated the production `traffic-policy` Ed25519 signing key while keeping legacy signature verification fallback for older cached revisions. - **Per-site bandwidth & stall telemetry** (#1851): Records closed TCP/UDP byte totals, flow durations, and stalled zero-download TCP attempts to power global site quality monitoring in Ops Console.

# Tono 0.0.67
Build 67 is a ground-up redesign of the interface, full Simplified Chinese localization, and one important account fix.
- The whole app speaks Chinese now: every screen, error message, and menu, including the errors the network helper reports during startup. - Sign-in is redesigned: a cleaner welcome screen, email and Apple sign-in side by side, a six-digit code that submits itself, and readable error messages with a Retry button where one was missing. - If your account is at its device limit, the sign-in screen now lists your devices and lets you remove one on the spot — previously it told you to fix it from a screen you could not reach. - Servers are named by city (洛杉矶, 东京, 盐湖城…) with a landmark icon per city — palm, torii gate, castle keep, mountain lake, waterfall — instead of a wall of identical entries, and the grid adapts to the window. - Dark mode is a true black glass; status colors, latency bands, and accents are consistent across every screen. - The connect control shows your selected city and latency, lights the Tono mark up when the tunnel is live, and the dashboard names the residential line your assistant traffic (Claude, ChatGPT, Grok) uses. - Switching servers and exporting logs confirm with a toast; latency results roll in as they land; motion respects Reduce Motion.
The privileged helper is unchanged, so this update does not ask for an administrator password.

# Tono 0.0.66
Build 66 is Build 65's code, published from Tono's own repository rather than a fork of someone else's. Nothing about routing, the kill switch or the app itself changed; if you are on Build 65 you already have every fix this contains, and the update is worth taking only so that later ones reach you from the place they will keep coming from.
- The download and update addresses now point at Tono's own repository. Build 65 was published from a fork, and everything it linked to lived under that fork's name. - The Windows side of the same release moved with it, and its update check no longer goes to an address blocked from mainland China. That does not affect this build; it is the reason the pair moved together.
The privileged helper is unchanged at 3.12.2, so this update does not ask for an administrator password.
